let _ (i : Fin (rankBound f)) : Module.Finite R (Ideal.span {rankIdempotent f i}) := Module.Finite.span_singleton R _
exact Module.Finite.equiv (DirectSum.linearEquivFunOnFintype R (Fin (rankBound f)) fun i ↦ Ideal.span {rankIdempotent f i})
explanation: Mathlib provides finiteness of a finite direct sum when each summand is finite. The target is equivalent to that direct sum; each summand is a singleton-generated ideal, hence finite. Typeclass inference in the existing proof uses the direct-sum finiteness instance.
